_meta.purpose: Bundle-size budgets enforced by scripts/bundle-budget.cjs (verify.sh Tier 2). Budgets are in GZIP bytes — that's what users actually pay over the wire. Raw byte sizes vary with esbuild settings; gzip is the stable comparison.
_meta.policy: When a budget needs to grow, bump it INTENTIONALLY in the same PR that adds the weight. The gate's only job is to make growth visible at review time.
_meta.patterns: Match against dist/assets/<filename>.js. First matching budget wins; files matching nothing are reported but not budgeted (Firebase third-party chunks deliberately escape — we don't control their size and Vite's chunking is opaque).

budgets.name: main entry (login bundle)
budgets.note: What an unauthed visitor downloads on cold load. Was 211 KB before #19's code splits; now ~99 KB after the push-notifications PR B i18n keys (notifications preferences screen — master toggle, 6 category toggles, devices list, iOS-without-PWA copy, EN + FR) landed in the inlined locale bundle. Budget at ~103 KB caps further regression — bump on intentional growth.

budgets.name: AuthedApp shell
budgets.note: FamilyProvider + AppShell chrome + AccountScreen + IosPwaHintBanner (F15, PR E). Was 20 KB before #20's per-route splits; now ~6.2 KB after PR E adds the iOS-PWA hint banner (mounted in AppShell so it must ship in this chunk — non-iOS users self-suppress at runtime, but the code still lands in the bundle). Tight budget keeps the post-auth shell small.

budgets.name: NotificationsRoute (push container)
budgets.note: Lazy route that wires the preferences screen to the live FCM service: two onSnapshot subscriptions (userPrivate + fcmTokens subcollection), four async handlers (request-permission/register, unregister, category write, device-row delete), iOS-without-PWA detection, and preferences coercion. PR G grew this from a 4 KB stub to ~9 KB once the no-op callbacks became real wiring (registerToken/unregisterToken/Notification.requestPermission/setDoc). Carved out separately from the other Route chunks because the FCM messaging import baseline pulls roughly 4 KB even before any logic — the general per-route budget would have to be loosened for everyone otherwise.

budgets.name: per-route chunks
budgets.note: Each lazy feature route (Dashboard, Calendar, Board, Chores, Allowance, Family). ChoresRoute is the heaviest at ~5.8 KB (includes AddChore sheet); the rest are 2-5 KB.

budgets.name: Accessibility statement
budgets.note: Static AODA-required content. Has a hard upper bound from the section structure + i18n keys (~4 KB today).
